title: MZ RPG Maker MZ VisuStella Battle System CTB Turn Order Issue

posts.author: Kiiray
posts.body:
Hi! I'm using RPG Maker MZ with the VisuStella BattleSystemCTB plugin, but I'm having a problem with turn order. Sometimes when it's the player's turn and I use a skill, the player's character gets pushed back in the turn order, even though the skill doesn't have any negative speed adjustments. This happens completely randomly and I'm not sure why it happens. Has anyone experienced this before, or does anyone know how to prevent characters from being pushed back in the turn order when they shouldn't be?
Here are all the Plugins that I'm using:

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
The first, logical step to troubleshoot any issue with a plugin would always be to turn off
all
other plugins, save your project, start a new game, see if you still have the issue.
Especially when you have so many plugins in your project, no one else can really do a lot until you narrow down whether it's a plugin conflict or something that's bugged in the CTB by itself (in which case, you should file a bug report with VisuStella).
